as_told.title: Levenda: DeLonge pointed to the Prometheus myth

plain: Around 2015, one of the most trusted advisers of the musician Tom DeLonge, who was then pursuing the UFO question, sent a long email asking, "how much do you know about Greek mythology?", pointing toward the myth of Prometheus, who stole fire from the gods for humans. The writer Peter Levenda, who says the email was sent to him and DeLonge, tells this. Michels repeats it secondhand from Levenda, saying figures close to space launches urged people like DeLonge to study Greek mythology, without mentioning an email, a hint that insiders may see the old myths as a key to the phenomenon.
